content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Project Scientist Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Scientist position at IIT Kanpur is 09 September 2026. Ensure you apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or a Postgraduate degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience in thin film electronics to be eligible for the Project Scientist role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 31,600 to Rs. 78,400.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist position in this recruitment drive by IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Kanpur Project Scientist recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position at IIT Kanpur is a contractual job, meaning it is offered on a fixed-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Kanpur Project Scientist recruitment is P.Rect./R&D/2026/161.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist position at IIT Kanpur will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208016.
